title: Preparation and application of a barium sulfate descaling and deblocking agent for low-permeability reservoirs
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23862-23869
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00379F, Paper
Open Access

Yang Haien, Xie Xuan, Dou Miao, Wei Ajing, Yan Tong, Lei Ming, Ma Chao
During water injection development in low-permeability reservoirs, BaSO4 scaling is prone to occur due to incompatibility between high-salinity formation water and injected water, severely affecting oilfield development efficiency.
